headword: {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}

definitions.explanation: Travel organized for a group of people, typically with a set itinerary, guide, and group pricing. Includes company trips, school excursions, and package tours.

examples.japanese: {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Hokkaido on a group tour.

examples.japanese: {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}→個人旅行：27279_kojinryokou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Group tours are often cheaper than individual travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}{旅館|りょかん}→温泉旅館：25209_onsenryokan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We stayed one night at a hot spring inn on a company group trip.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧ (group, organization) + ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (travel). Covers any organized group travel — company trips ({社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}), school excursions (⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧), and commercial package tours.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}する→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧: to join a group tour
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企画|きかく}する→企画する：29396_kikakusuru⟧: to plan a group tour
- {団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧: group travel discount
- ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧{団体旅行|だんたいりょこう}: overseas group tour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{個人|こじん}{旅行|りょこう}→個人旅行：27279_kojinryokou⟧: individual travel — self-planned travel without a group
- ⟦パッケージ→パッケージ：11699_pakkeeji⟧⟦ツアー→ツアー：08285_tsuaa⟧: package tour — a commercial tour product with set itinerary, often used for overseas trips
- {社員旅行|しゃいんりょこう}: company trip — specifically for employees of a company
- ⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧: school excursion — a multi-day educational trip organized by schools
